verdict.rationale: Xero ships AI features (JAX for reconciliation and invoicing, AI bill extraction), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
